method: Retain all prior 37717 protection/error pairs. Reconstruct exactly coded TRAIN gold paths for the 1044 missing targets with no old close-prefix comparison. Dynamic programming uses real language transitions, history clipping and token priors; compare earliest lost and maximum-raw-deficit prefix checkpoints (at most two rivals each), plus three actual complete-pool rivals. Positive paths are shadow-only, never added to inference. Diagnose beyond-static-option-cap targets but do not fit impossible final/prefix targets. Targets with dictionary-coded non-Han punctuation and no legal Han decoder path are diagnosed and excluded from reconstructed comparisons.
static_eligibility: Upper bound only: first24 vocabulary tokens; ranks25..64 require 2..8 characters and context; first64 dictionary Han candidates or HK particles at later ranks. Selected-only DP uses actually generated options. Context-selected eligibility depends on surviving paths; neither flag alone establishes the earliest causal failure.
calibration: Fixed L2 values0.003,0.015 and strengths0.5,1 on new100 validation and previously observed700. Require no first/top5/top20 loss on new100, and at least one first/top5 gain across both sets; old700 aggregate first/top5/top20 nondecreasing and per-set first/top5 regression<=1percentage point. Select equal-set mean first rate,then top5,then top20,thenMRR,then lower strength and higher L2. No qualify means reject without opening new500.
guards: Selected arm must pass all observed3893 rows: aggregate first/top5/top20 nondecreasing and per-set first/top5 regression<=1percentage point, exact-code/unique20 bounds, Single32/32 after three confirmations, Java/Python/Lint and paired warmed desktop wall/CPU ratios<=1.2. Compare final-only shared-weight control at the selected strength to identify search contribution; report tradeoffs without assigning answer-specific overrides.
independent: Freeze exact candidate source/model hashes and all qualification evidence before decoding new500 once per baseline/candidate. Adopt only if first/top5/top20 counts do not decrease and at least first or top5 has a net gain. No post-reserve weight, threshold, code or case changes. Otherwise restore production baseline and retain research artifacts.
delivery: No APK; preserve0.6.39/code46, fixed signing, learning storage and existing Fold7 layout. No1.0 claim without original major-release gates and physical device evidence. Previously opened sets are calibration, never fresh evidence.
freeze: Written before any structured fit or candidate decoding. Existing100/700/3893 are calibration. Unopened joint_ranking/heldout.tsv500 only after exact candidate/guards frozen. No extra grid expansion after results.
before_first_fit_amendment: Observer now records no-legal-Han-path targets instead of aborting on historical punctuation-bearing TRAIN labels. No fit or candidate decode occurred before this amendment; all other pilot choices unchanged.
observation_scope: All1821 missing TRAIN targets, retaining the1044 gap diagnosis separately. Gap1044 produced zero legal score-learnable full targets (791 static option barriers;253 non-Han punctuation labels), so inspect other777 missing targets before fitting. No candidate results observed before scope amendment.
training_stop: If reconstructed comparisons are empty, stop without fitting identical old models or opening reserve500.
offsets: Prefix offsets compare reconstructed real accumulated transition scores with actual raw beam rivals; lookahead is not included in these new offsets. Complete offsets use the harder of the raw gap and raw-plus-SentenceRanker gap. PRR3 categorical head/visible gates are not simulated for a missing teacher candidate; actual inference validation is mandatory.
